title: The Sports Desk
description: Sports night. Steve has proof the big game was filmed months ago. Gary held the orange slices. It was a union job.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're back on Snazzie FM. We're talking sports tonight, which means Barry finally gets to participate.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I know one sport, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And that's one more than last week. Our first caller has a hot take. Steve, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Ronnie, okay, I don't have a lot of time, they could trace this. <p:0.3> The big game on Sunday? It's already been played.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: ...It's on Sunday.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: It was played in March, Barry. In a warehouse. They film all the games months ahead.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That would save so much on scheduling.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: That's what I'm saying, Ronnie! The players don't even know. They reshoot the reactions later.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Steve, I watched a game live last week. It went to overtime.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Overtime is added in post, Barry. <p:0.4> For drama. For the ratings.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It is always the most dramatic when it matters most.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Because it's WRITTEN that way, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Steve, the players have families. Someone would talk.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: The families are in on it, Barry! <p:0.3> Why do you think athletes have so many cousins? Those are handlers.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That is a lot of cousins, when you think about it.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It is a normal amount of cousins, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: And the refs? <p:0.3> The refs are actors, Barry. That's why they wear the stripes. So you can't recognize them at the grocery store.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The stripes are so players can see them, Steve.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: That's what they told you, Barry, and you wrote it down like a good little fan.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Yeah, the kid's half right. <p:0.4> But it's not March. They film 'em in January. I've seen the warehouse.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: ...You've seen the warehouse?

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: I worked the warehouse, Steve. I held the orange slices. <p:0.3> Union job.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Gary, what is the warehouse like? Paint us a picture.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Big, Ronnie. Cold. <p:0.3> They keep all the weather in there. Rain machine, snow machine, one fan the size of a bus for the windy games.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: So outdoor games, in the rain... are filmed indoors, with a rain machine.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Now you're getting it, Barry. <p:0.3> Real rain is too unpredictable. They can't afford a continuity error.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The production value really is incredible when you think about it.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Gary, did you ever see the crowd? <p:0.3> Are the fans real?

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Painted, Steve. <p:0.3> One big painting of a crowd. They wheel it in. Forty thousand fans, one canvas.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I have been to a game. I was in the crowd. I am a real person.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Are you though, Barry? <p:0.3> Or were you painted that day.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I was not painted, Gary.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Then how do I know about the orange slices, Barry?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Checkmate, Barry. He knows about the oranges.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Everyone knows about the oranges. That's just sports.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Then who cut the oranges, Barry? <p:0.3> Go on. Name him.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I don't know the orange guy's name, Gary. Nobody knows the orange guy.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And that, friends, is the biggest cover up in sports.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We'll be right back. The game's already over. <p:0.3> It's been over for months.
